title: Praxis provenance interchange record
description: The versioned, portable form in which Praxis provenance crosses a system boundary (RQ-ROS-2026-A013). It is the artifact provenance of RQ-ROS-2026-A004 (the same `contributions` mapping and the same actor), plus lineage (`derivedFrom`) and optional verbatim lineage snapshots (`sources`), under an explicit contract name and semantic version. It is not a second identity model: every contribution and actor is exactly the Praxis shape. Unknown fields at every level are preserved by conforming consumers. Self-reported provenance, not authentication, authorization, or evidence quality (RQ-ROS-2026-A010).

contract.description: Contract discriminator. Always this value; a consumer that sees a different value MUST NOT treat the object as Praxis provenance.

version.description: Semantic version of this contract. A consumer supports a major version; it accepts any minor/patch of a supported major (preserving fields it does not model) and preserves an unsupported major verbatim without modifying or appending to it.

subject.description: Optional namespaced reference to what this provenance describes, for example `aegis:fault/F-17` or `praxis:RQ-ROS-2026-A001`.

contributions.description: Who contributed what, keyed by execution (EXE-...) or contribution (CTB-...) ID. Identical to artifact provenance: append-only, at most one `created`, nothing precedes `created`, an agent contribution is keyed by an execution.

derivedFrom.description: Lineage: the references this subject was derived from. Lineage names sources; it never makes a source's contributors contributors of the subject.

sources.description: Optional verbatim provenance snapshots of lineage sources, keyed by a reference that MUST also appear in `derivedFrom`. Carried so that a consumer which cannot resolve the source still keeps its originating actors and executions. Never merged into `contributions`.

reference.description: An artifact ID (for example RQ-ROS-2026-A001) or a namespaced foreign reference `<system>:<local-reference>`.
